tools.detail: Postman is an API development and testing platform that empowers developers to create, share, test, and document APIs. It provides a user-friendly interface for designing and executing API requests, making it an essential tool for modern software development. Key features include a rich set of request types, environment management, and collaboration tools. Postman is suitable for developers of all skill levels and is widely used for both SOAP and RESTful web services. Its pros include a powerful request builder, easy-to-use UI, and extensive documentation. However, some users may find the pricing model limiting for larger teams, and the tool may not be as powerful as some enterprise-grade solutions for complex API management.
